slides.title: [[Duplicates]] hatao
slides.code:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER
   (PARTITION BY email
    ORDER BY id) AS rn
  FROM customers) t
WHERE rn = 1;
slides.note: Har email ki **pehli** row rakho, baaki duplicates out 🚮

slides.why: SQL Server error dega; MySQL/Postgres mein numbering **random** 🎲
